milestones.title: Highly multiplexed mammalian metabolic engineering via shotgun screening
milestones.summary: A shotgun screening approach simplifies and scales metabolic engineering in mammalian cells.

milestones.title: All-RNA-mediated targeted DNA integration using engineered R2 retrotransposons
milestones.summary: Researchers developed engineered avian R2 retrotransposons to enable site-specific DNA integration in human cells using an all-RNA-mediated approach.

milestones.title: Engineered avian R2 retrotransposons enable targeted DNA integration in human cells
milestones.summary: Researchers engineered avian R2 retrotransposons to achieve site-specific DNA integration in human cells, a breakthrough for gene therapy.

milestones.title: Deep learning perturbation models outperform baselines on calibrated metrics
milestones.summary: Calibration-aware evaluation demonstrates deep learning models surpass baseline methods in perturbation prediction.

milestones.title: AI-guided optimization yields thermostable mRNA vaccines stable at 37°C for 2 months
milestones.summary: AI-driven framework AGENT enables mRNA vaccines retaining full bioactivity after 2 months at 37°C, allowing cold-chain-free delivery via microneedle patches.

milestones.title: AI-guided optimization yields thermostable mRNA vaccines stable at 37°C for 2 months
milestones.summary: AI framework AGENT engineers mRNA vaccines retaining full bioactivity after 2 months at 37°C, enabling cold-chain-free microneedle patch delivery in primates.

milestones.title: AI-accelerated discovery of thermostable mRNA–LNP vaccines
milestones.summary: Data-efficient AI enables rapid identification of thermostable mRNA–lipid nanoparticle vaccine formulations, advancing vaccine stability and deployment.

milestones.title: Lipid nanoparticles optimized for large RNA cargo enhance in vivo genome editing
milestones.summary: Researchers improved lipid nanoparticle design by incorporating RNA cargo size, enabling better tissue targeting and enhanced in vivo genome editing.

milestones.title: LC-1 lipid nanoparticle enables efficient delivery of large gene editors in mice
milestones.summary: New ionizable lipid LC-1 improves endosomal escape and enables efficient genome editing in liver, lung, and brain of mice for large mRNA cargo.

milestones.title: Photolabile oligonucleotides enable spatially resolved single-cell transcriptomics and epigenomics
milestones.summary: A new photolabile oligonucleotide system uses topological light gradients to achieve spatially resolved single-cell measurements linking epigenome regulation to gene expression.

milestones.title: Alkermes reports pioneering ADHD data for orexin agonist
milestones.summary: Alkermes releases pioneering clinical data for orexin agonist in ADHD, potentially expanding the drug class beyond narcolepsy into broader patient populations.

milestones.title: Versatile nanopore sensor simultaneously identifies four analyte classes with 98.7% accuracy
milestones.summary: A modified bacterial porin nanopore coupled with machine learning simultaneously identifies amino acids, nucleoside monophosphates, saccharides, and peptides with 98.7% accuracy, enabling native glyco

milestones.title: Engineered nanopore simultaneously identifies saccharides, amino acids, peptides, and ribonucleotides
milestones.summary: A modified nanopore achieves simultaneous detection of four major biomolecule classes and their modifications, marking a breakthrough in multiplexed single-molecule sensing.

milestones.title: Biomimetic cells enable new platform for T cell mechanotransduction studies
milestones.summary: Researchers develop biomimetic cells as a novel synthetic biology tool to investigate mechanical force sensing in T cells, opening new avenues for immunotherapy research.

milestones.title: Moderna mRNA flu vaccine receives FDA approval
milestones.summary: Moderna's mRNA-based influenza vaccine gains FDA approval, marking the first regulatory clearance for an mRNA flu vaccine.

milestones.title: Prefill-Only Decision Models Reduce Inference Cost by 10-100x
milestones.summary: New prefill-only decision models eliminate decoding to make single calls one to two orders of magnitude cheaper than generative language models of similar scale.

milestones.title: Format-aware fusion enables fast FP4 pretraining at 160B-token scale
milestones.summary: New format-aware fusion technique co-designs FP4 quantization producers and consumers to achieve efficient Llama-3 8B pretraining over 160B tokens using native MXFP and NVFP formats.

milestones.title: TutlAit v1: first crowdsourced Moroccan Tamazight speech dataset with Arabic transcriptions and regional accent labels
milestones.summary: First publicly available Moroccan Tamazight speech corpus with Modern Standard Arabic transcriptions and explicit regional accent labels, collected via a dedicated crowdsourcing web application.

milestones.title: BACKDROP benchmark evaluates agent robustness under real-world disturbances
milestones.summary: BACKDROP introduces a new benchmark that quantifies how much agent capability degrades when everyday hazards like conflicting instructions or environmental changes are introduced during task execution

milestones.title: Forecast-Dojo: Replayable Benchmark for LLM Forecasting Agents
milestones.summary: Forecast-Dojo introduces a replayable environment with 1,568 Polymarket events and 18.8M tokens for benchmarking and training LLM forecasting agents using historical prediction-market data.

milestones.title: New evaluation protocol detects sequential reappearance in diffusion model unlearning
milestones.summary: Researchers identify sequential reappearance in diffusion data-point unlearning and propose a target-level evaluation protocol to track forgetting persistence across sequential deletion requests.

milestones.title: STAM: State-Transition-Aware Memory for Clinical LLM Agents
milestones.summary: STAM introduces a state-transition-aware memory framework enabling LLM agents to track patient state changes while preserving clinical history for improved reasoning over medical records.

milestones.summary: Researchers introduce ALEE, a cross-lingual embedding evaluation framework tested on over 275 languages, revealing persistent gaps in semantic representation for low-resource languages.

milestones.summary: A new multimodal AI model deployed on the ZTF alert stream improves early classification of astronomical transients by up to 40% over light-curve-only methods.

milestones.summary: New Agentic Transaction Processing framework proves four safety properties and achieves 5.2-6.6% throughput overhead while rejecting all targeted violations in benchmarks.

milestones.title: Theoretical sample complexity bounds for Gumbel-Max watermark proportion estimation
milestones.summary: Researchers establish matching upper and lower bounds for estimating watermark proportions in LLM outputs, showing pivotal reduction increases sample complexity versus full observation.

milestones.summary: Anthropic unveils OSS Scanner, a free opt-in service using its strongest AI models to periodically scan open-source projects for vulnerabilities.
